theme.description:
A web-accessibility–focused style for eXeLearning 4, for the materials of the National eTwinning Support Service in Spain (https://etwinning.es/). Derived from the Cedec style, by the same authors: developed by Ignacio Gros for Cedec, and designed by Cedec and Ignacio Gros.
iDevice icons by Francisco Javier Pulido Cuadrado, under the same license as this style (Creative Commons BY-SA 4.0, http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/). Modified: recoloured to the palette of this style.
Atkinson Hyperlegible Next (text) and Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono (code), licensed under the SIL Open Font License, Version 1.1 (https://openfontlicense.org/open-font-license-official-text/). Copyright: Braille Institute of America, Inc. (https://www.brailleinstitute.org/freefont). The full license text is included in theme/fonts/OFL.txt.
Navigation icons (theme/img/icons.png), attachment icons (theme/img/clip.png, theme/img/clip_on.png), external link icon (theme/img/external_link.svg) and message block icons (theme/img/icon_info.png, icon_success.png, icon_warning.png, icon_alert.png, icon_danger.png and icon_download.png) based on Material Icons by Google (https://fonts.google.com/icons), under the 2.0 version of the Apache License (https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0.html).
Creative Commons license badges (theme/img/licenses.gif): trademarks of Creative Commons (https://creativecommons.org/policies/), shown only to identify the license of the content. They are not covered by the license of this style.
